Tara (CSM): Heads up 
-- Starlite Logistics (mid-market) flagged for low onboarding progress. Stalled at step 4 (policy mapping). Weekly seat activity down 38%. Renewal in ~6 weeks. Thinking a rapid save: focused enable + minor credit.
Diego (AM): Any reliability issues or mainly config/ux?
Tara (CSM): Mostly policy mapping confusion; also two engineers saw elevated token spend and aren't sure why quotas changed after last deploy. No exec sign yet.
Lin (Success Eng): I can run a 10-min diagnostics (policy rules, quota history, recent deploy diffs). If it's a config drift we can patch in under an hour.
Marta (PS): I'll prepare a 25-min "policy mapping clinic": hands-on walkthrough, one-liner scripts to reconcile policies, and a quick rollback plan. Recommend offering 1 hour PS + $600 credit.
Diego (AM): Approve credit. Keep offer tight. Aim to outreach within 48h and run clinic within 72h.
Tara (CSM): Draft outreach below:
```
Subject: 25-min policy clinic to unblock Starlite onboarding
Hi [Name],
We noticed onboarding is paused at policy mapping and some unexpected quota changes. Can we schedule a 25-min clinic this week to run a diagnostics pass and reconcile policies? We'll include 1 hour of PS and a $600 account credit to help smooth the next steps.
Thanks,
Tara (CSM)
```
Lin (Success Eng): I'll attach a pre-call checklist: recent quota-change audit, last deploy hash, and a short repro script. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/cs/checks/policy-clinic
Marta (PS): Success criteria: 1) mapping completed and validated, 2) no quota surprises for 72h, 3) seat activity +20% within 7 days. If not met, escalate to "retention escalation" and prep a downgrade-mitigation option.
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check in 7 days (1830006120). :white_check_mark:
